A sore throat is often caused by a viral infection and usually improves within a week. Resting and drinking plenty of fluids may help a sore throat feel better.

See a doctor if a sore throat lasts longer than a week, if swallowing becomes very painful, or if there is a high fever with the sore throat.

Emergency signs with a sore throat include drooling, being unable to swallow, or noisy breathing.
